en.title: A Formal Limitation on Learning Human Language From Textual Corpora
en.hook: Can a listener recover speaker intent from utterance form alone? An information-theoretic look at the limits of text-based language learning.
key_takeaways: Analyzes the relationship between utterance form and speaker intent information-theoretically
Proves fundamental limits for text-based listeners, including advanced text featurizers
Demonstrates theoretical barriers to recovering full human semantics from text corpora alone

zh.title: 从文本语料库学习人类语言的形式化局限性
zh.hook: 听众能否仅从话语形式恢复说话者的真实意图？通过信息论探讨基于文本的语言学习的本质局限。
key_takeaways: 从信息论视角分析话语形式与说话者意图之间的映射关系
证明了包括高级文本特征提取器在内的所有文本基听众的局限性
揭示了仅通过文本语料库学习无法完全恢复人类语义的理论壁垒
